Dl-591
DIAGNOSTICS - BODY CONTROL SYSTEM
INSPECTION PROCEDURE
1 Check brake fluid level warning switch (See page BE-46).
Replace the brake fluid level warning switch. G
2 Check wlreharness and connector between brake fluid level warning switch and
body ECU (See page IN-30).
Repair or replace wlreharness or connector. G
Proceed to next circuit Inspection shown on
problem symptoms table (See page
D1-642).
